_doc: #1506 Background policy declaration (read by bgpolicy/BgConfig). essential = never restricted by any action or bulk action or Super Saving: the roles are resolved on the device (self = SuperApp, dialer = default dialer, sms = default SMS app, launcher = current home, keyboard = current input method, systemui) and the packages / prefixes cover the platform and the vendor builds of the same roles. fleet_prefixes mark the fleet apps (listed first). bulk.include_system false = Restrict all non-essential touches user-installed apps only. hunger.top = rows Battery Hunger ranks.
